priorityList: Maintain Lightning Shield and Thunderstrike Ward at all times.
Cast Stormkeeper if Ascendance has more than 10 seconds remaining on cooldown or is ready to use immediately.
Cast Ascendance if Stormkeeper is on cooldown for at least 15 seconds.
Use Voltaic Blaze or Flame Shock to maintain damage-over-time effects and trigger Master of the Elements.
Cast Earthquake (or Elemental Blast at exactly 3 targets) to spend Maelstrom and apply Lightning Rod to enemies.
Use Lava Burst when Purging Flames is active or when you have a Lava Surge proc to trigger Master of the Elements.
Cast Tempest when the Master of the Elements buff is active to maximize damage.
Cast Tempest if you have 2 stacks available, provided you are not currently using Stormkeeper stacks.
Use Chain Lightning when Stormkeeper is active, as long as you have room for the generated Maelstrom.
Spend Maelstrom on Earthquake (or Elemental Blast) if you are near your maximum Maelstrom capacity.
Cast Tempest whenever it is available.
Use Chain Lightning as your primary filler for 3 or more targets.
If moving, use Flame Shock, Voltaic Blaze, or Frost Shock to maintain activity.
Sync offensive trinkets and racial abilities with Ascendance or when Stormkeeper is unavailable.
